$Comment: Cursed Geodes in plain stone: while Hallow's Eve runs, breaking any rock a player did not place
can turn one up, and it lands where the block broke. The file name is the row's id.
When names the moment and the blocks: BreakBlock on every block id starting Rock_. Chance is the
row's own odds as a percent (1 is one block in a hundred). A row has no gate of its own, so the
season rides on each roll's Conditions: calendar_live reads 1 only while the event runs, and a
roll whose condition fails hands nothing over. The first roll is the find and carries the Cue
that shows the toast; the second adds one more geode on Harvest Moon nights.
Ore has a row of its own (Hallows_Eve_Geode_Find_Ore.json), because a row answers one name
pattern and the most specific pattern wins a name. A server owner retunes or switches off this
row by its id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/bonus-rows.json.
